message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"The two prior precision increases moved from 12 to 14 to 16 phase bits, and only the 16-bit LUT/linear design met the 8-LSB quality target, but at the highest mapped area so far (1584.56 um^2). Since increase_precision and increase_table_capacity have no legal unvisited neighbors, switching architecture is the best remaining way to explore a different area/quality tradeoff, potentially reaching acceptable accuracy with lower area than the current 16-bit LUT."}
